data.description:
### 1. Technical Environment
* **code_version:** dc3b288e5831592d4a69f58004fc91a14e5d465b
* **shim:** .claude/scripts/dso
* **plugin cache:** /Users/joeoakhart/.claude/plugins/cache/digital-service-orchestra/dso-dev/1.16.11

### 2. Incident Overview
* **Scenario Type:** User-Flagged Behavior

#### Expected Behavior

Per CLAUDE.md namespace policy and the sprint skill: scripts under the plugin cache (e.g. plugins/dso/scripts/sprint-drift-check.sh) should be invocable via the host project shim as `.claude/scripts/dso sprint-drift-check.sh <args>`.

#### Actual Behavior

Session of 2026-05-12, sprint Phase 1 drift detection:

```
.claude/scripts/dso sprint-drift-check.sh f61f-7e0a-36d3-4e7d --status=open
# dso: command not found: sprint-drift-check.sh
# dso: (looked for /Users/joeoakhart/digital-service-orchestra/plugins/dso/scripts/sprint-drift-check.sh)
```

The shim looks for the script in the host project repo's plugins/dso path, not the plugin cache. The script exists at /Users/joeoakhart/.claude/plugins/cache/digital-service-orchestra/dso-dev/1.16.11/scripts/sprint-drift-check.sh but the shim has no fallback. Workaround was `bash <absolute-plugin-cache-path>/scripts/sprint-drift-check.sh ...` which violates the namespace policy.

### 5. Skills and Workflows
* Shim: .claude/scripts/dso (host project copy)
* Caller: /dso:sprint Phase 1 (Drift Detection Check)
* Fix sketch: shim should cascade lookup: (1) host repo plugins/dso/scripts/<name>, (2) $CLAUDE_PLUGIN_ROOT/scripts/<name>, (3) ~/.claude/plugins/cache/.../scripts/<name>. Currently appears to only check (1).
data.title: [.claude/scripts/dso]: shim dispatch missing for sprint-drift-check.sh (and likely other plugin-cache scripts) -> command not found
